test_title: PYST 56: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). I sits third to the left of J. E is an immediate neighbour of both G and H. G sits third to the right of J. F sits second to the right of I. What is the position of K with respect to H?
solution:
Given, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

I sits third to the left of J.

E is an immediate neighbour of both G and H.

G sits third to the right of J.

F sits second to the right of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f93fc5db30187e7404d635558ceec017109e65e56056e51a334d50d6c3e4fb13.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4212597f09c0e9a54a3c14c313ec1d695cf26f86dc708dc869bf544598f00132.png] 

And K sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/788b8818c044effe2849d4f20df3533c9f2086994c5df78a18e28980c7307ae9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f1c98e100fd3620beb90d55aeeb1a9285b38524b30958469bf37665c0dea6b0.png] 

The position of K with respect to H is third to the left.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
